card.name: Hyphens and slashes in boxed warnings
card.fires_on: The hyphen or slash joining two terms inside an all-caps boxed warning heading, such as DEMENTIA-RELATED or SPINAL/EPIDURAL. It also fires on a few dashes or spaces in ordinary web text.

modes.label: Hyphen in capital headings
modes.description: A hyphen links a noun to RELATED or ASSOCIATED in an all-caps warning title.
modes.example: INCREASED MORTALITY IN ELDERLY PATIENTS WITH DEMENTIA<<->>RELATED PSYCHOSIS See full

modes.label: Slash between paired terms
modes.description: A slash joins two capitalized medical terms in a warning heading.
modes.example: WARNING: RISK FOR SERIOUS HYPERSENSITIVITY<</>>ANAPHYLAXIS REACTIONS

modes.label: Dash in web text
modes.description: A dash follows a list of names in general prose.
